title: V5 Epic 4 E-4-1 Helm chart skeleton evidence
description: Strict (additionalProperties:false + unevaluatedProperties:false) evidence artifact for V5 Epic 4 slice E-4-1 (Helm chart skeleton). Captures decision, write-set, invariant audit, guard-flag pin (3 const false), and cross-AI provider distinctness. Bound to .claude/plans/E-4-1-HELM-CHART-SKELETON.md + tests/test_epic_4_1_helm_chart_skeleton.py.

write_set.description: Sorted list of files MODIFIED or ADDED on the slice branch relative to origin/main; MUST exactly equal `git diff --name-only origin/main..HEAD` (sorted).

guard_flags.description: All three runtime guard flags MUST stay const false in this slice. Schema pins them; module-level forbidden-change audit re-verifies key-string absence in chart files.

reviewer_providers.description: Cross-AI provider list (implementer + reviewer). Provider strings MUST be distinct (HARD RULE Cross-AI Peer Review: provider-level distinct).

no_workflow_mutation.description: Pinned true: this slice MUST NOT touch .github/workflows/**. Test enforces via git diff allowlist.

no_pyproject_change.description: Pinned true: this slice MUST NOT modify pyproject.toml (F8 absorb: [k8s-helm] extra out of scope).

chart_template_no_live_command.description: Pinned true: chart NOTES.txt + README.md MUST NOT contain `kubectl apply`, `helm install`, or `helm upgrade` strings.

ao_kernel_version_pinned.description: ao_kernel.__version__ at slice author time (chart appVersion pin reference).

cross_ai_review_thread.description: Optional Codex MCP thread id for post-impl review (filled in after review submission).
